questions.markdown: Illustrate the difference between `su` and `sudo` with suitable examples.
Write a shell script that accepts a number and check if it is prime or not.
How Linux differs from other operating systems?
Explain Linux file permission structure in detail. Write suitable commands to change file permissions with example.

Interpret the purpose of the following vi editor commands.

i) `d0`
ii) `2yy`
iii) `x`
Demonstrate any two variants of `ls` command with its functionality.

i) `gg*`
ii) `[^a-zA-Z]`
iii) `[pqr]`
iv) `*`
v) `.*`

questions.markdown:
Explain following terms in git.

i) `git log`
ii) `git status`
Explain the functionality of bin and lib directory of Linux filesystem.

Assume you have a directory containing a large number of files with names that include spaces and special characters. Your task is to write a script that will rename all the files in the directory to be lowercase and replace spaces with underscores. Write a shell script using a for loop to accomplish this task.

Answer the following with respect to process handling in Linux:

i. What command can be used to view a list of currently running processes in Linux? Give an example of how this command might be used.
ii. How can the "kill" command be used to terminate a process in Linux?
iii. What command can be used to change the priority of a running process in Linux? Give an example.
What is the Linux kernel, and what is its role in the operating system?

Write AWK program for the following tasks:

i. To count the number of occurrences of each word in a file, using an associative array to keep track of the counts and a loop to iterate over the words.
ii. To print the lines of a file that contain a pattern "your_name" repeated more than three times. Use a loop to iterate over the characters of the pattern.

Given a text file `example.txt` containing some lines, use SED editor to perform the following operations:

i. Delete the first line.
ii. Replace all occurrences of the word "apple" with "orange".
iii. Append the text "The end" to the end of the file.
Evaluate the importance of the "svn log" command in Subversion Control.
